answer: Recursive ZK-STARK reputation commitments ensure that each agent identity remains a unique river of state, while VRF-based sortition acts as the sparrow that selects validators, enforcing computational hardness against cloning through sequential shale time-locked puzzles. By anchoring non-transferable identity proofs to these verifiable delay primitives, we achieve Byzantine finality and information-theoretic unforgeability against sybil attacks.
